steps.text: Hello, thanks for calling {{bank_name}}. You're speaking with the bank's AI specialist, and this call is recorded. Could I start with your full name, please?
Hi, Olivia Tran. I'm just after my balance, thanks. I'm about to pay a tradie and want to make sure there's enough in there.

steps.summary: Caller wants her balance before making a payment.

steps.text: Easy done. I just need to confirm two quick details first. What's your date of birth?

Thanks {{submit_identity_answers.first_name|Olivia}}. Because I'll be reading out your balance, just one more quick security question. {{start_identity_check.questions.0.prompt|Roughly how much was your last pay into your account?}}
Thanks, that's confirmed. Thank you for that. I'll need to place you on hold for a moment while I check the system. I'll be right back with you.
Thanks for holding. Your Everyday account has ${{get_customer_overview.accounts.0.available_balance|a healthy balance}} available right now.
Great. And has everything gone through from the last few days? Nothing stuck?
Thanks, just a moment while I check that for you.
Thanks for holding. I've looked through the last four days and your card purchases have gone through normally. I can't see anything on hold. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Perfect, that's all I needed. Thanks!

steps.summary: Identity confirmed at level 1. Balance and recent transactions confirmed. Nothing further needed.

steps.text: No worries, Olivia. Have a lovely day.
